evidence.quote: I preferred to lower the target range for the federal funds rate by 25 basis points.
I believe that beginning to move our policy rate at a gradual pace toward its neutral level will help maintain the labor market near full employment
With tariff-related price increases likely representing a one-time effect, it is appropriate to look through temporarily elevated inflation readings.
However, the labor market has become less dynamic and shows increasing signs of fragility.
I think that we should start putting more weight on risks to our employment mandate.
I see the risk that a delay in taking action could result in a deterioration in the labor market and a further slowing in economic growth.

parsed.rationale: The speaker explains a dissent in favor of a 25 bp cut and advocates gradually moving policy toward neutral, arguing that tariff effects on inflation are one-time. They put more weight on downside risks to employment and growth, a clearly dovish signal.
